name: Acalabrutinib
drug_class: Bruton tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor (covalent, second generation)
route_note: oral capsules or tablets twice daily

discovery.by: Acerta Pharma (Tjeerd Barf, Allard Kaptein and colleagues)
discovery.note: A more selective covalent BTK inhibitor with a butynamide warhead, designed to reduce off-target kinase effects.

tagline: More selective second-generation BTK inhibitor for CLL and mantle cell lymphoma
summary: Acalabrutinib is a second-generation covalent BTK inhibitor with fewer off-target kinase effects than ibrutinib. It is approved for chronic lymphocytic leukaemia and mantle cell lymphoma, and in a head-to-head trial showed similar efficacy to ibrutinib with less atrial fibrillation.
mechanism: Acalabrutinib and its active metabolite ACP-5862 bind covalently to cysteine 481 of BTK, irreversibly blocking B-cell receptor signalling and survival of malignant B cells.
Its reactive butynamide group and scaffold give minimal inhibition of EGFR, ITK and TEC, which is thought to lower rates of rash, diarrhoea, bleeding and atrial fibrillation compared with ibrutinib.
uses: Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (alone or with obinutuzumab)
Mantle cell lymphoma (relapsed, and untreated with bendamustine–rituximab)

history.title: AstraZeneca investment
history.detail: AstraZeneca agrees to acquire a majority stake in Acerta Pharma.

history.title: CLL results
history.detail: Byrd et al. (NEJM) report high responses in relapsed CLL.

history.title: FDA approval
history.detail: Accelerated approval for previously treated mantle cell lymphoma.

history.title: CLL approval
history.detail: ELEVATE-TN and ASCEND lead to approval in CLL.

history.title: ELEVATE-RR
history.detail: Non-inferior to ibrutinib with less atrial fibrillation in previously treated CLL.

history.title: Tablet formulation
history.detail: Tablet form approved that can be taken with acid-reducing agents.

history.title: Untreated MCL
history.detail: FDA approves acalabrutinib with bendamustine and rituximab for untreated mantle cell lymphoma (ECHO trial).

pk.half_life: about 1 hour (active metabolite ACP-5862 about 7 hours)

facts: Headache is common in the first weeks and usually responds to caffeine or simple analgesics.
